english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something thrilling, and in a sexual context for something sexually stimulating.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that causes a sudden rush of excitement, such as a film, ride, or experience.
This is the all-purpose choice for something refreshingly thrilling or exciting.
Use this for something thrilling or exciting enough to make people hold their breath.
Use this when an event or experience is thrilling or emotionally electrifying.

examples.english: The stunt scenes in this film are really exciting.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲啲特技場面真係好刺激。
